missionGuard: An exposure-improvement headline additionally requires zero added case-wise mission failures. Mission completion requires visiting the common science waypoint within 0.25 m and returning with reserves at the common deadline. Abandoning the objective cannot count as overall superiority.

pairedBootstrap.interpretation: Monte Carlo variability conditional on this generator and reused source references, not uncertainty about real astronaut performance

stopAudit: Stationary NO FEASIBLE ROUTE actions are included. A common mission route and three observed-direction alternatives provide the counterfactual. Count a stop only when a physically/resource-feasible moving alternative has strictly less predicted contact, or no greater contact and strictly better goal progress. This narrow metric is not a complete human stop taxonomy.
staleInformation: Use the inherited maxSensorAge and coastSeconds identically. A coasting estimate older than maxSensorAge is never labeled clear. Beyond coastSeconds, no verified escape command is shown.

latencyProtocol.states: For each suite select the first three case IDs in sorted order; pool states at times 0,20,40,80,120 from every evaluated arm. All policies receive each identical pooled state. Deterministically rotate arm order.
latencyProtocol.includes: all policy forecasting, candidate generation and common feasibility checks
latencyProtocol.excludes: offline stop counterfactual audit, JSON loading, WebGL rendering and worker transport; cold first call reported separately

frozenRegression: Rerun all 54 old holdout cases and all six original v8 arms including its labeled Oracle diagnostic. Compare contact, minimum clearance, distance, elapsed time, hold duration, return and budget fields at tolerance 1e-7. Oracle is excluded from the new primary comparison and never supplied to any new policy.
